# games-app
> 150+ browser games, Japanese learning suite, professional AI engines, FastMCP 3.2 server, Tauri 2.0 desktop app.

Generated on: 2026-08-02

## Architecture

```
User/Browser  ->  Vite React (10986)  ->  proxy /api, /mcp  ->  FastAPI Gateway (10987)
                                                                    ->  FastMCP mount at /mcp
                                                                    ->  games-mcp tools (15)
Desktop (Tauri)  ->  WebView  ->  embedded React dist  ->  spawns PyInstaller backend on 10987
Docker  ->  compose.yml  ->  gateway + 7 engine containers
Firebase Realtime Database  <-  browser games + MCP backend (games/{gameId} nodes)
```

## Ports

| Service | Port | Description |
|---------|------|-------------|
| Frontend (Vite) | 10986 | React 19 SPA dashboard |
| Backend (FastAPI) | 10987 | REST /api/v1/* + FastMCP /mcp/ |
| Stockfish | 10780 | Chess engine API |
| Shogi (YaneuraOu) | 10781 | Shogi engine API |
| Go (KataGo) | 10782 | Go engine API |
| Edax | 10785 | Othello engine API |
| GNU Backgammon | 10786 | Backgammon engine API |
| OpenSpiel | 10787 | 119-game framework API |
| MoHex | 10775 | Hex engine API |

## MCP Tools

| Category | Tools | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| Gameplay | new_game, make_move, get_game_state, join_shared_session, list_shared_sessions | Core game lifecycle + shared session listing |
| Analysis | get_ai_move, analyze_position_detailed, check_engine_health | AI engine integration |
| Management | create_tournament, register_for_tournament, get_player_statistics, update_player_rating | Tournament/ELO |
| Orchestration | intelligent_game_analysis, adaptive_learning_session, design_coaching_program | Agentic workflows |

## Multiplayer & Firebase Sync

- Shared sessions live in the Firebase **Realtime Database** under `games/{game_id}`
  (project `games-collection-c2e25`, europe-west1). Browser games
  (`multiplayer.js`, `chess-multiplayer.js`, `unified-multiplayer.js`) and the MCP
  backend read/write the SAME nodes.
- Browser side: WebSocket (local network) first, Firebase fallback (internet);
  Firebase branches of `unified-multiplayer.js` are implemented
  (create/join/send/move, per-room `value` + `child_added` listeners, 6-char room codes).
- Backend: `sync_service.py` (firebase-admin SDK), `list_shared_sessions(limit,
  status_filter)`, `new_game(host_name=...)` create browser-compatible nodes;
  `join_shared_session` pulls remote state into the local cache.
- Honest status: `sync_manager.status()` reports `configured` / `mock` / `auth_error`;
  tools return real data or a structured, honest failure — never fake sessions.
- Status + next steps: `docs/MULTIPLAYER_STATUS.md`.

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `GAMES_BACKEND_PORT` | 10987 | Gateway port |
| `GAMES_MCP_LOG_LEVEL` | INFO | Log level |
| `GAMES_TAURI` | 0 | 1 when running inside the Tauri shell |
| `STOCKFISH_URL` / `SHOGI_URL` / `GO_URL` | localhost:10780/81/82 | Engine URLs |
| `EDAX_URL` / `GNUBG_URL` / `OPENSPIEL_URL` / `MOHEX_URL` | 10785/86/87/75 | Engine URLs |
| `FIREBASE_DATABASE_URL` | — | RTDB URL (games-mcp/.env) |
| `FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON` | — | Service account path/JSON (games-mcp/.env) |
| `GAMES_FRONTEND_DIST` | web_sota/dist | React dist override for Tauri/PyInstaller |

## Tauri Desktop

- Native app: Tauri 2.0 Rust operator + WebView2
- Backend: Python server frozen with PyInstaller, embedded in bundle.resources
- Installer: Single NSIS .exe with kill hooks
- Process: Operator.exe -> spawns games-app-backend.exe from app_cache

## Docker

```yaml
services:
  games-gateway:  # Port 10987
  stockfish-engine:  # Port 10780
  shogi-engine:  # Port 10781
  go-engine:  # Port 10782
  edax-engine:  # Port 10785
  gnubg-engine:  # Port 10786
  openspiel-engine:  # Port 10787
  mohex-engine:  # Port 10775
```

## Build Commands

| Command | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| `just serve` | Start FastAPI gateway on 10987 |
| `just dev-web` | Start Vite frontend on 10986 |
| `just dev` | Start both backend + frontend |
| `just build-native` | Full Tauri release build |
| `just build-sidecar` | PyInstaller backend only |
| `just lint` | Ruff check |
| `just typecheck` | TypeScript typecheck |
| `just e2e` | Playwright tests |
| `just docker-up` | docker compose up -d |

## MCPB Package

manifest.json contains the v0.2 MCPB manifest. Packaged assets in assets/prompts/ following the 3-4-100 rule.
